decisions.story_title: CVE-2026-86405: signature verification bypass in Sipay PrestaShop Virtual POS module (CVSS 9.8)
decisions.reason: Fresh disclosure of a critical (CVSS 9.8) CWE-347 improper cryptographic signature check in the Sipay PrestaShop Virtual POS module versions 26.8.1 through 26.9.1. A payment-module signature bypass carries direct e-commerce fraud potential; no existing story covers it. Offseq radar is the disclosure record, not commentary.
